Keywords: trend, time-series, line, growth, timeline, progress, rate of change, continuous period
Accessibility Notes: Distinguish series by line style, direct labels, or markers as well as hue so meaning does not depend on color alone (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1).
A11y Fallback: Direct series labels or distinct line styles; a data table with timestamps and values

Keywords: compare, categories, bar, comparison, ranking, magnitude, ordering
Accessibility Notes: Visible value labels make exact values readable without hover. A sort control helps when ranking is the question.
A11y Fallback: Visible value labels; the same values as a table or export

Keywords: part-to-whole, pie, donut, percentage, proportion, share, dominant segment
Accessibility Notes: Slices told apart only by hue convey meaning by color alone (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1); label slices directly or add patterns. Angle comparisons are imprecise, so give exact percentages as text.
A11y Fallback: Direct slice labels with percentages; a stacked bar or table with the same values

Keywords: correlation, distribution, scatter, relationship, pattern, cluster, outlier, continuous variables
Accessibility Notes: Combine marker shape with hue so groups stay distinguishable without color (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1). Provide the underlying values in a table.
A11y Fallback: Data table with the plotted values; distinct marker shapes per group

Keywords: heatmap, heat-map, intensity, density, matrix, calendar, activity grid
Accessibility Notes: Pair the color scale with a labeled legend and readable cell values. Values revealed on hover must also be reachable by keyboard focus (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.13, 2.1.1).
A11y Fallback: Cell values available on focus as well as hover; a downloadable grid table with row and column labels

Keywords: geographic, map, location, region, geo, spatial, choropleth, spatial distribution
Accessibility Notes: Label major regions in text and make regions reachable by keyboard. Area size can mislead comparison; check whether a bar chart answers the question better.
A11y Fallback: Region text labels; a table sortable by region name and value; keyboard-navigable regions

Keywords: funnel, flow, conversion, drop-off, pipeline, stages, sequential process
Accessibility Notes: Show each stage's count and drop-off as text and keep stage labels visible.
A11y Fallback: A linear list with stage name, count, and drop-off; keyboard traversal

Keywords: performance, target, kpi, gauge, goal, threshold, progress, benchmark
Accessibility Notes: Show the value and its relation to the target as text beside the chart; do not rely on color or needle position alone (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1).
A11y Fallback: Value and target shown as visible text; if the value updates live, announce meaningful changes rather than every update

Keywords: forecast, prediction, confidence, band, projection, estimate, uncertainty
Accessibility Notes: Distinguish actual from forecast with line style and labels, not color alone, and describe what the band represents.
A11y Fallback: Toggle actual and forecast independently; legend text that names each line style

Keywords: anomaly, outlier, spike, alert, detection, monitoring, deviation
Accessibility Notes: Mark anomalies with shape and a text annotation, not color alone (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1).
A11y Fallback: Text annotation per anomaly; a summary list of anomalies beside the chart

Keywords: hierarchy, nested, treemap, parent, children, breakdown, drill, budget breakdown
Accessibility Notes: Small rectangles cannot hold labels and area is hard to compare precisely; label large areas and offer the hierarchy as a navigable structure.
A11y Fallback: A collapsible tree table; treemap as a supplementary overview

Keywords: flow, process, sankey, distribution, source, target, transfer
Accessibility Notes: Links distinguished only by color fail without color perception (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1). Check legibility at narrow widths and provide the flows as a table.
A11y Fallback: Flow table (source, target, value); a keyboard-traversable node list

Keywords: waterfall, cumulative, variance, incremental, bridge, delta, budget variance
Accessibility Notes: Encode increase and decrease with a direction marker or sign as well as color, and label every bar.
A11y Fallback: Table with a running-total column; signed values or direction markers per row

Keywords: radar, spider, multi-variable, attributes, dimensions, comparison, feature comparison
Accessibility Notes: Radial axes make precise comparison hard, and harder as axes are added; test with representative data and offer a precise alternative.
A11y Fallback: Grouped bar chart or table with the raw values

Keywords: stock, trading, ohlc, candlestick, finance, price, volume
Accessibility Notes: Do not rely on a red/green pair alone. Hollow versus filled bodies is a common second cue (conventionally hollow when the close is above the open); confirm the convention your users expect.
A11y Fallback: OHLC data table with sortable columns; numeric summary of change

Keywords: network, graph, nodes, edges, connections, relationships, force
Accessibility Notes: Node-link diagrams are hard to perceive and navigate non-visually; do not make one the only representation.
A11y Fallback: Adjacency list (node, node, weight); a tree view when the structure allows

Keywords: distribution, statistical, spread, median, outlier, quartile, boxplot
Accessibility Notes: State the summary statistics in text and say how many outliers are shown.
A11y Fallback: Summary table (min, Q1, median, Q3, max, mean); outlier count in the caption

Keywords: bullet, compact, kpi, dashboard, target, benchmark, range
Accessibility Notes: Keep values visible as text, not hover-only, and label qualitative ranges in words rather than color alone.
A11y Fallback: Values always visible; range bands labeled with their threshold text

Keywords: waffle, percentage, proportion, progress, filled, grid
Accessibility Notes: Keep the percentage visible as text and give the chart one accessible name and description rather than announcing every cell.
A11y Fallback: Percentage text always visible; a legend naming each category

Keywords: sunburst, hierarchy, nested, proportion, radial, circle
Accessibility Notes: Outer rings get thin and hard to label or compare as depth grows; provide the hierarchy in a navigable text form.
A11y Fallback: Collapsible indented list with percentages; breadcrumb for the current drill-down level

Keywords: root cause, decomposition, tree, hierarchy, drill-down, attribution, contributing factors
Accessibility Notes: Expand and collapse must work by keyboard, and each node should expose its label, value, and share of the parent to assistive technology.
A11y Fallback: Keyboard expand/collapse tree; node label, value, and contribution available as text

Keywords: 3d, spatial, immersive, terrain, molecular, volumetric, point-cloud
Accessibility Notes: Depth, occlusion, and rotation make 3D plots hard to read and to convey non-visually; check whether a 2D projection answers the same question.
A11y Fallback: 2D projection views and a data table

Keywords: streaming, real-time, ticker, live, velocity, pulse, monitoring
Accessibility Notes: Moving or auto-updating content that starts automatically and runs alongside other content needs a way to pause, stop, or hide it (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.2). Respect reduced-motion preferences.
A11y Fallback: Pause and resume control; current value as visible text; static rendering when reduced motion is requested

Keywords: sentiment, emotion, nlp, opinion, feeling, text-analysis, word cloud
Accessibility Notes: Word clouds encode frequency by size and position, which is imprecise and not conveyed to screen readers; pair them with a ranked list.
A11y Fallback: Sortable list by frequency with a sentiment column; word cloud as a supplement only

Keywords: process, mining, variants, path, bottleneck, log, event
Accessibility Notes: Large process graphs are hard to navigate; summarize the main paths and bottlenecks in text.
A11y Fallback: Path summary table (variant, frequency, duration); bottlenecks listed as text
